address: Barrio El Puente 13, Oruña de Piélagos, 39477, Spain
bio: An aristocratic property that will charm guests thanks to its attractive colonial/mountain-style decor and various terraces. In its classically styled dining space, one of which is inside the library, explore a traditionally inspired à la carte specialising in meat, including premium options such as Macharra aged beef and ox. We recommend taking the advice of owner César before ordering....
